sizing.notes: Risk per trade is 10% of current closed-trade equity, never above $40. Size only from closed equity, never after a win streak.

drawdown.notes: 20% below high-water mark: halve risk. 35% below HWM: pause new entries and ask Thomas. 3 straight stops or $40 lost in a day: no new entries for the rest of that day.

filters.notes: Re-run the breakout study on the latest 30 days. Review volume and turnover gates, the candle/age gate, the liquidity band, turnover threshold, and RugCheck risk names. Monthly checklist: hit rate of passers vs runners missed, pass count per run, share of passers dumping more than 40% within 6 hours.
